spec.userPrompt:
Question: Complétez : « Quand je suis arrivé, Paul ___ déjà son dîner. »

Choices:
A. [MARKED CORRECT] avait fini
B. allait finir
C. finira
D. finirait

responses.raw:
VERDICT: TRUE
REASON: The sentence uses "déjà" (already) with "quand je suis arrivé" (when I arrived), which requires the plus-que-parfait tense to show an action completed before another past action. "Avait fini" is correctly the pluperfect form meaning "had finished."
